qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: National mobile towers and fixed fiber infrastructure provide a durable physical asset base, but stringent wholesale open-access regulation in Norway and aggressive Nordic retail price competition keep 5-year ROIC chronically sub-hurdle (~8-10%) with real ARPU lagging inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC ~8-10% < 12%, sub-inflation pricing power, REJECT). State-backed Nordic telecom incumbent owns critical physical network assets, but heavy ongoing 5G/fiber capex, strict Norwegian wholesale open-access regulation, and intense retail competition prevent earning excess economic returns on capital.
qualitative.evidence: Reported ROCE has hovered between 8.9% and 11.5% over 2020-2024, with GAAP ROIC averaging ~8-10%, failing the 12% threshold. Significant leverage (>NOK 100B net debt including lease liabilities; net debt to EBITDA ~2.2x). Restructuring of Asian holdings (True Corp JV in Thailand, CelcomDigi in Malaysia) has resulted in historical write-downs without lifting core Nordic capital returns.
